notes:
Summary: Polaris runs session-based personalization for a global ecommerce platform. Primary goal is sub-60ms p95 generation for short recommendation/rerank responses (<=64 tokens) at 1.5-2k QPS during peak. Critical to reduce per-request cost for embedding and rerank pipelines (cost sensitivity). They will evaluate hosted vs dedicated; strong interest in Redwood Optimize for batching/caching/quantization guidance.

Key technical requirements and asks:
- Workloads: real-time personalization (session context), reranking for recommendations, embeddings for cold-start similarity.
- Latency targets: p95 <= 60ms for generation up to 64 tokens; p99 < 120ms preferred for critical checkout flows.
- Throughput: baseline 800 QPS average, peaks up to 2k QPS regionally.
- Cost target: reduce per-1000-requests TCO by at least 30% vs current managed endpoint (they currently pay high per-token rates).
- Model preferences: open/bespoke Llama-family variants acceptable; want options for quantized int8/int4 profiles.
- Routing/fallback: region-aware routing, fallback to smaller quantized model when capacity constrained.
- Caching: strong interest in prefix/KV caching for session continuity (reuse previous KV to cut compute).
- Batching: want advice on batch windows that respect latency SLOs (micro-batching, dynamic batch sizing).
- Benchmarks: asked SE to provide perf harness (wrk-style) and a reproducible script to measure p50/p95/p99 across model variants, batch sizes, and quant profiles.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, audit logging, KMS key options, EU data residency required for subset of customers.

Direct quote from head of platform: "We can tolerate a tiny bump in average latency if it cuts unit cost by a third — but spikes kill conversions. Need hard numbers from a POC."

POC scope agreed (high level):
- 2-week perf POC: run hosted and dedicated scenarios, sweep quantization (fp16 -> int8 -> int4 if feasible), batch window experiments, enable KV caching.
- Deliverables: latency/throughput matrix, cost-per-10k requests model, recommended config (batch size, cache TTL, quant profile), SOC2 docs.

POC success criteria (customer):
- p95 generation <= 60ms on representative traffic mix,
- cost <= target ARR profile leading to < $250k/yr incremental spend,
- security checklist green for VPC + EU residency.

Action items (AE/SE):
- Asha to share perf harness and example payloads by 2026-03-12.
- Jordan to escalate SLA ask and draft commercial terms for dedicated pools.
- Send SOC2 + security FAQ (done: drive link).
